# Native resource execution across installation

Actual CLI/app-server 0.167.0 and Bun 1.4.4 observations from a new disposable home, workspace and loopback Git marketplace. This is separate from the earlier zero-turn install fixture. Default tests read evidence only; they never start a server, install a plugin, execute the controller or change trust.

`observed.json` records six completed native `thread/shellCommand` executions. Each row correlates the owned thread, native turn and completed command item, source, exact command, output and exit code. The real historical version checker and `spec.ts settings` succeeded before installation. Repeating their identical paths in the same old native thread after selected installation failed with missing-file/module errors. Both candidate paths succeeded in a fresh native thread. Only the three package version declarations changed in the fixture candidate.

This is **direct user-shell execution, not model-selected execution**. Native command items report `source: userShell`, `pluginId: null` and `scriptPath: null`. The controller supplied the pinned paths. The scratch account read returned account absent and authentication required, without requesting a token refresh. No model turn was started, no credential copied, no model/permission override supplied and no hook trust bypassed. Old loaded-skill/model attestation, positive hook trust, CLI/desktop resume fences and rollback remain unverified. Do not promote this evidence into those capabilities.

`historical-version.py.txt` is the exact read-only historical script, frozen with its SHA-256; tests verify the bytes and never run it. `controller.ts.txt` archives the experiment driver with only worktree/controller-scratch paths replaced. It is experimental provenance, not a production adapter or a runnable default test. It depends on the existing bounded probe RPC and a separately created owned home/socket/Git source.

Reproduction flow: extract full historical commit `22e7ec7b6aae89c4a13c299e1dff024a26a1d1bc`; wrap its plugin in a disposable marketplace; serve a verified bare Git repository on 127.0.0.1; perform native marketplace add and selected plugin add; start an isolated standalone app-server; run account/snapshot/create/shell through the controller; update only the disposable source's three version declarations; scoped marketplace upgrade and selected plugin add; repeat old commands, create fresh thread and run candidate commands; inspect exact owned turns/empty terminal lists before archive; stop and independently verify the two owned server PIDs are absent.

Both native threads were archived after all six shell turns completed and native terminal lists were empty. Both owned servers were stopped. No live plugin install/profile, default daemon, project or personal hook configuration changed. Detailed procedure, setup errors, limits and the unapproved retention proposal live in `docs/specs/codex-runtime-support/research/phase-1/2026-11-08-resource-execution-observations.md`.
